style_and_pipeline_audit.status: owner final applied through Chapter 1250; chat-only fast path enabled
style_and_pipeline_audit.notes: The owner's Chapter 1250 prose is the governing version. New locked rulings include Acting Sect Master, the Heaven-Connecting Sea of Clouds, viewing flowers through the fog, hide in plain sight, time and time again, shared the same qi with intertwined branches, the soft persimmon, and seeking the Golden Core through Heart Demons without inventing a formal Heart Demon Dao. Future chat-only chapters should deliver prose before repository maintenance. Provisional first drafts no longer trigger handoff commits or CI. After owner approval or edited prose, extract reusable rulings and publish one atomic glossary, style, continuity, world-reference, and state update. Chapter prose remains in chat only.

chat_translation_handoff.instruction: Before translating later chapters, read state.json, config.json, the canonical terminology TSV, the core style guide, continuity.md, every terminology, style, owner-edit, world-reference, and continuity supplement named in this handoff, and chat-fast-path.md. Repository files outrank chat memory, and the latest owner ruling wins. Preserve one target paragraph per source paragraph. Italicize explicit and unmistakable implicit internal thought. Direct thought generally uses present tense, with past or past perfect reserved for genuine recollection, anterior events, counterfactuals, and other real sequence needs. Use natural contractions except those ending in 'd. Preserve all source meaning, numbers, logical relations, idioms, allusions, jokes, and metaphor chains in polished xianxia English. Do not force a literal calque when the owner has locked a natural equivalent. 小友 is little friend. 滴天髓 is Drop of Heaven's Essence. 大宗师 is Grand Ancestral Master, a Zhuangzi-derived Remnant Consciousness place. 大隐隐于市 is hide in plain sight in Chapter 1250's context. 雾里看花 is viewing flowers through the fog. 又双叒叕 is time and time again. 接天云海 is the Heaven-Connecting Sea of Clouds. 代掌教 is Acting Sect Master as a formal office. In Chapter 1250's recollection, 证心魔 is seeking the Golden Core through Heart Demons, not an invented formal Heart Demon Dao. Keep chapter prose in chat unless the owner explicitly requests repository chapter files. Under the chat-only fast path, deliver the translated prose before metadata work, make no provisional first-draft handoff commit, and update glossary, style, continuity, world reference, and state once in an atomic commit only after owner approval or edited prose.
